claim_ceiling: Finite-size U(1)-conserving random-circuit transport. A fitted z is an effective exponent for the declared register, gate family, seeds and time window; it is not a thermodynamic-limit result unless cross-size scaling establishes stability. This is not black-hole evaporation or a gravitational Page curve.

model.gate_family: nearest-neighbour brickwork with independent Haar U(1) x U(2) x U(1) gates
observables: absolute density-gradient centroid and second central moment
mean width squared and standard error
model.width_definition: For rho_i(t)=<n_i>, define g_i=abs(rho_(i+1)-rho_i), x_i=i+1/2, xbar=sum(g_i*x_i)/sum(g_i), w^2=sum(g_i*(x_i-xbar)^2)/sum(g_i). Compute w^2 per independent seed before averaging.

preregistered_protocol.seed_schedule: seed=0xB1A5 + size_index*100000 + sample_index; size_index follows [6,8,10,12], sample_index starts at zero
preregistered_protocol.fit_window: ceil(N/2) through 2*N inclusive; time window is declared before inspecting fitted exponents
preregistered_protocol.uncertainty: leave-one-seed-out jackknife for z and per-layer standard error of width squared
preregistered_protocol.finite_size_comparison: Compare z(N), jackknife intervals and fit R-squared across all four sizes. Also run a shifted preregistered window in a separate sensitivity study rather than tuning the primary window after seeing its result.

diffusive.interpretation: width squared grows linearly with time

ballistic.interpretation: width squared grows quadratically with time

kpz_like_superdiffusive.interpretation: width squared grows approximately as t^(4/3)

reference_hypotheses.other: Report the fitted effective exponent and uncertainty without forcing one of the reference labels.

acceptance.finite_size_stability: Proposed target: max-min z across largest three sizes <= 0.2 with overlapping uncertainty intervals; otherwise report finite-size drift/unresolved.
acceptance.universality_claim_requires: A stable scaling window, multiple sizes, seed uncertainty, window sensitivity, and exclusion of ballistic/diffusive/KPZ reference alternatives by the declared uncertainty.

implementation.jackknife: leave-one-seed-out, recompute the log-log exponent after omitting each seed
diagnostics: jackknife standard error and approximate 95% interval

negative_controls: fit width squared versus time only and call the resulting slope a measured dynamic exponent
select the fit window after inspecting the fitted z
classify a universality class from a single register size
bootstrap layer points as if they were independent seed realizations
discard low-R-squared or censored/saturated points without recording the exclusion
